summary: The authors’ figure data confirm that Gr3 was the GLP-1/GIP dual agonist. HypoExplorer compares six Gr3 hypothalamus RNA libraries with eight vehicle libraries. The published RNA results cover liver, white adipose tissue and skeletal muscle, while the hypothalamic gene-labelled panels measure protein abundance seven hours after a single dose. No public author result could test the registered RNA contrast. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10427-5) · [GEO deposit](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE314029)
openIssues: GEO reports seven daily treatments. The publication describes 12 days for the peripheral RNA experiment. A future hypothalamic RNA result would reopen the review if it identifies the libraries, dosing and harvest schedule, and handling of the two repeat libraries.
